title: Momoi Airi — Shine On Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
I'm guessing we're all exhausted after that performance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I feel like I'm going to sleep like a baby tonight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But Idol Lovers was so much fun...!
It was crazy how the crowd made the stage shake by cheering so loudly...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And a lot of people seem to be talking about how amazing our performance was on social media.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, take a look.
There are all these comments about our performance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Not only are they talking about us, but a ton of people are even talking about the performance we did with ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
This person wrote a whole paragraph about how amazing you did, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Your smile made me swoon!”
“I'm totally your fan now!” Look at all this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
Hehe. It's always nice to get that in words!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's keep reading...
Oh, this person said, “I lost my voice while MORE MORE JUMP! was on stage.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, everyone did cheer at the top of their lungs today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As a result, the audience and the performers were able to become united as one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really was an amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm probably never gonna forget what happened today for as long as I live.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I might even dream about it as I sleep!)
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 3-E

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm back, Airi...
The restroom was very crowded and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Oh, that's rare. She's taking a nap.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should probably wake her since lunch is almost over, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh...
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She seems to be having a nice dream...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe... Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I love you all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, is she dreaming about...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Wait, did I fall asleep...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good morning, Airi.
It's almost time for our next class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were smiling while you were asleep just now. Did you have a pleasant dream...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Was I making that kind of face...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. You smiled and said, “I love you all,” so I thought your dream had to be very nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, it was nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was dreaming about our performance at Idol Lovers yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I said that I might dream about what happened yesterday, but to think that what I said would actually come true.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It only seems natural.
I mean, yesterday's show was just that good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is, I also dreamed about it this morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so happy about what happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I've been watching you practice and work so hard to become a super idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And your hard work paid off...
I got to see you shine on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of those things, as well as getting to stand next to you as it happened, filled me with so much joy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It sounds like you're happier than I am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still... Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we can't rest on our laurels!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we got to perform at Idol Lovers, and I got to fulfill a dream of mine. But our real goal is still way up ahead, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we don't have time to get all sentimental!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (First, Idol Lovers... Then, Butokan. And finally, a show at the Dome. To get closer to becoming my ideal idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We gotta keep trying more and more!
